question: 決定：要不要核准「故事做完回報切片進度」補完後的設計並開始實作。我建議核准：照你上次的要求，設計加了一步，有地圖擴充的流程裡每張任務在待辦關卡要寫一行「屬於哪個故事」或「不屬於任何故事加理由」，沒寫就擋；其他照原設計：每張有切片的任務歸檔時我在對話裡回報切片完成與剩餘的故事和每個完成故事的 PR，不自動重畫畫布，PR 連結只出現在回報裡，不做故事宣告、改列已建檔任務的計數。核准即接受這些，以及這一步上線當天 relay 有 31 張、qnow 有 11 張待辦任務會被點名要補那一行。

artifacts.summary: Batch 21 ideation sitting, one design per question on the Captain's word; second attempt after his revise asked for one added step. FO ran design_surfaces.py check on the revised design: exit 0 (2026-11-11). The worker's report, not re-run by FO: 135 of 137 relay tasks and 163 of 163 qnow tasks carry no Story line, this workflow is unaffected because it does not list journey-map, and on the day it ships the idle look names 31 relay and 11 qnow backlog tasks; no criterion is verified against a candidate. D1 to D3 are unchanged from the first attempt. The added step takes Gap 1 of the backlog task journey-map-progress-and-provenance and leaves its other gaps. The design names a new ADR; FO reserves its number before the implementation dispatch. Criteria are AC-1 to AC-15.
